principle: Every scientific coordinate shown in the primary README figures must descend from a governed mathematical or computational geometry source. Manual SVG coordinates are limited to framing and typography.

research-hero.object: computed affine multilayer system + Euclidean L2 viability geometry

coupled-network-3d.object: R3 multilayer affine embedding + orthographic publication projection

graph-to-viability.object: constraint intersection + exact Euclidean L2 nearest-boundary distance

research-state.object: SVD projection of explicitly conceptual 4D research-state vectors

research-pipeline.object: continuous cubic-spline trajectory gamma(t) with seven anchors

scientific_boundary: Computed geometry does not imply empirical calibration. The current V3 viability margin is the Euclidean special case rho_2 with g=I; a non-Euclidean rho_g requires a separately justified metric. Shape and color never increase evidence strength; conceptual research-state coordinates are not measured data; 3D layer separation is not geographic elevation.
